rubric.description: Correctly computes x squared and y squared (e.g. x * x or Math.pow(x, 2))
Sums the two squared values and applies Math.sqrt to the sum
Correctly extracts the first character of firstName (e.g. charAt(0) or substring(0, 1))
Correctly extracts the first character of lastName and converts both extracted characters to uppercase
Returns the two uppercase characters concatenated in the correct order
Divides n by 10 using floating-point division (e.g. n / 10.0), not integer division
Uses Math.round to round the quotient to the nearest whole number
Multiplies the rounded value by 10 and returns the correct int result (with a cast if needed)
